attributeDescription: Regions where buyers can order the product from
Setting refers to the method or style in which gemstones are mounted in the earring.
Pearl Type refers to the specific classification of the pearl, such as freshwater, Akoya, or Tahitian.

Brand Colour refers to the shade of the product. Sometimes it can be a name derived from only alphabets or it can be alphanumeric as well. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Closure Type refers to the mechanism used to fasten the earring, such as a hook, clasp, or screw back
Pearl Length refers to the measurement of the pearl's length from end to end, impacting its appearance in the earring.
qualifierDescription: Pearl Length - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the pearl length. Units should be filled only in singular form. The possible value is mm.

attributeDescription: Warranty Service Type refers to the process on the customer's part to claim the warranty. In case of any repair/damage to the product, who/where the customer has to contact and how would the company then process the customer's request (either by sending an engineer or by asking the customer to bring the product at a certain Service Center etc).
Sapphire Colour refers to the hue, tone, and saturation of the sapphire gemstone, impacting its overall appearance.
Ruby Colour refers to the hue, tone, and saturation of the ruby gemstone, impacting its overall appearance.
Amethyst Colour refers to the hue or shade characteristic of the amethyst gemstone featured in the earring design.
Silver Purity refers to the percentage of pure silver content in the metal used for the earring.
Other Dimensions refer to any additional information on the dimensions of the product that would be useful to a customer.
exampleValue: 15 x 10 x 18 inches||12 x 8 x 16 inches

attributeDescription: Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Gemstone refers to any precious or semi-precious stones integrated into the earring's design for ornamental purposes.
